sloka: पीत्वा तैलं प्रनृत्ताश्च प्रहसन्त्यो महास्वनाः ।लङ्कायां भस्मरूक्षायां प्रविष्टा राक्षसस्त्रियः ।। ५.२७.३७।।।।
transliteration: pītvā tailaṁ pranṛttāśca prahasantyo mahāsvanāḥ ।laṅkāyāṁ bhasmarūkṣāyāṁ praviṣṭā rākṣasastriyaḥ ।। 5.27.37।।।।

translations.english: "All the demonesses in the city of Lanka which had turned dry, reduced to ashes, were dancing, laughing and shouting loudly drunk with oil..
